name: month-end-close
title: Month-end close
desc: Record new receipts, check the ledger, get your OK, then tell your accountant.

nodes.label: Scan receipts
nodes.task: list receipt files in this folder, record every one not yet in the ledger with the right category, then show this month's summary

nodes.label: Who owes me
nodes.task: show the aging report: who still owes money and how late

nodes.label: Ledger clean?
nodes.expr: every receipt recorded this month has a category other than Uncategorised and a source file

nodes.label: Write summary
nodes.prompt: Write a plain-language month-end summary for a small business owner: total spend by category, top three vendors, outstanding invoices and anything overdue. Keep it under 200 words.

nodes.label: Your approval
nodes.question: Here is the month-end summary. Send it to your accountant?
